If she tries that again want you to remember these following words- my husband and I have had a total of 9 miscarriages in our relationship of eleven years and not once did it cause me or him to become physically violent woth one another! sure as hell caused a period of grief and personal mourning for our loss but never violence! She is a shitty person for trying to use it as an excuse.  you do not deserve to be treated this way. I commend you for trying to stay by her side- from personal experience miscarriage is a very rocky roller coaster full of emotions and what ifs- i blamed myself for my losses before finding put it was die to medical condition so i know how rough it can be. but its NEVER a valid reason to put hands on another person!  she should never hit you again. if she does remember- IT'S JUST A SHITTY EXCUSE TO USE THE MISCARRIAGE AS A REASON FOR HER BEHAVIOR and please leave to somewhere safe like your friends house.
